escalate_action: Contact the flight surgeon or crew support.

extra_reasons.low_intake: Low food intake may also be adding to this.

sleep_hours.label: Sleep
sleep_hours.action: Protect a full sleep period tonight.
sleep_hours.howToMeasure: Log the hours you slept this morning.
sleep_hours.whyItMatters: Short sleep slows reactions and lowers mood.
sleep_hours.source: design value (context: NASA NTRS, Behavioral Challenges of a Mars Mission, ISS crews averaged just over 6 h a night)

mood.label: Mood and stress
mood.why: Mood and stress are {delta} {unit} worse than your usual.
mood.action: Take a short break, talk to a crewmate, and keep your routine steady.
mood.howToMeasure: Once a day, slide to a number from 0 (calm and happy) to 10 (very stressed). It takes about 10 seconds.
mood.whyItMatters: Strain can build up quietly in a small space. Your own trend shows it before it feels big.
mood.source: design value (context: stress ratings are a monitoring tool in NASA NTRS, Behavioral Challenges of a Mars Mission)

reaction_ms.label: Reaction time
reaction_ms.why: Reaction time is {delta} {unit} slower than your usual.
reaction_ms.action: Rest if you can and avoid risky tasks until your next test.
reaction_ms.howToMeasure: Do the 1 to 2 minute tap test once a day. Tap as soon as the signal appears. The app saves your median time.
reaction_ms.whyItMatters: Reaction time tends to slow when you are tired. It is an objective check next to how you say you feel.
reaction_ms.source: design value (context: the psychomotor vigilance task is a monitoring tool in NASA NTRS, Behavioral Challenges of a Mars Mission)

social_contact.label: Social contact
social_contact.why: Time with crew and family is {delta} {unit} less than your usual.
social_contact.action: Schedule a call with family or ground, or share a meal with the crew.
social_contact.howToMeasure: Log the minutes you spent talking with crew, ground or family today.
social_contact.whyItMatters: Less contact over several days can go along with lower mood and feeling cut off.
social_contact.source: design value (context: scheduled contact with ground and family is a countermeasure in NASA NTRS, Behavioral Challenges of a Mars Mission)

combined_strain.why: Several signs of strain together for 2 days.
combined_strain.action: Contact the flight surgeon or crew support.

disclaimer: Decision support using simulated data. It does not diagnose.
